compression_threads.description: Number of threads for compression; 0 lets btrfs auto-detect based on CPU count.

checksum.description: Enable checksumming during I/O (1=enabled, 0=disabled). Recommended to leave enabled.

ssd_optimization.description: Enable SSD-friendly optimizations during filesystem creation (1=enabled, 0=disabled).

block_size.description: Block size for mkfs.btrfs in bytes. Most commonly 4096 (4 KiB).

compression_type.description: Default compression algorithm for new filesystems. Supported: zstd, lzo, zlib, none.

delayed_alloc.description: Enable delayed allocation (1=enabled, 0=disabled). Improves fragmentation but may affect latency.

items.description: A mount option string (e.g., 'noatime', 'compress=zstd:1,ssd') to be passed to mount.

mount_options.description: List of mount options to apply via btrfs-mount helper or recommended defaults.

scrub_interval_hours.description: Frequency (in hours) for automatic btrfs scrub jobs (e.g., 168 = weekly). Set to 0 to disable.

auto_balance.description: Enable automatic background balancing (1=enabled, 0=disabled). Use with caution.

auto_balance_threshold.description: Data block group usage percentage threshold that triggers auto-balance (1–100).

max_stripes.description: Max stripes per device for mkfs.btrfs (0 = default, i.e., unlimited). Typically set for multi-device RAID.

default_raid_profile.description: RAID profile used by default for metadata/data in mkfs.btrfs. Options: single, dup, raid0, raid1, raid10, raid5, raid6.

metadata_dup.description: Enable metadata duplication (1=enabled, 0=disabled) for single-device filesystems. Increases metadata redundancy.

env_vars.description: List of environment variable assignments to export before running btrfs commands.
